shots.action: Flooded cabin, grey light. Close on a young woman lying across a settee, a gash on her forehead, sea water slopping a hand's width below her face, tins and a cushion drifting past. Her eyes snap open; she lifts her head, mouth open
shots.camera: Close above her face, drifting back

shots.action: She comes up through the hatch into daylight, eyes wide, head turning: the mainmast is a splintered stump in front of her, the rest of it over the side in a tangle of wire and torn sail
shots.camera: From the foredeck, low, past the stump, easing in

shots.action: From the stern: the wheel turns by itself, the cockpit is empty. She twists round in the hatch, searching, and shouts a name
shots.camera: Behind the wheel, pushing forward

shots.action: A crow in a long coat stands on the stump of the mainmast, arms folded, hat brim low, eyes half shut. He looks down at the wreckage, then at us, and speaks. Behind and below him she is still turning in the hatch, looking for someone
shots.camera: Low three-quarter on Rook, drifting in

shots.action: A black sky, rain, lightning. The yacht, small, heeling; behind her a wall of water with a white crest climbs higher than her masts ever were
shots.camera: Low on the water, the wave filling the frame behind the boat

shots.action: The wave takes her: the yacht is thrown onto her side and goes on over, keel to the sky, in a burst of white water
shots.camera: Off the bow, low, pushing in

shots.action: From high in the cabin: she lies where she was thrown, eyes shut, not moving. The light in the portholes goes from day to night and back to day while the water slops and the tins drift. A count of hours runs up to 27
shots.camera: High and wide, sinking slowly towards her

shots.action: On deck, close on a cleat: an orange safety line is still made fast to it and runs away over the side, swaying. She kneels, face set with dread, and her hand goes out to it
shots.camera: Close, tracking along the line

shots.action: Rook, at the stern rail, lifts the free end of the line into view: the steel ring on it has sprung open. He looks at it, and his head goes down
shots.camera: Three-quarter on Rook, the ring in the middle of the frame

shots.action: She stands at the stern rail looking back down the empty sea; her head sinks. Behind her Rook holds his hat to his chest. The camera pulls away and up: grey water in every direction
shots.camera: Astern of the yacht, pulling back and rising

shots.action: Cockpit, hard sunlight. The engine hatch is up. She turns the key: the engine shudders, coughs one puff of grey smoke and stops. Her shoulders drop
shots.camera: High three-quarter from the port side, easing in

shots.action: Below: she throws her weight on the bilge pump lever, back and forth, jaw set. The water in the cabin is going down round her legs
shots.camera: Beside the lever, looking forward at her

shots.action: On the coachroof she walks a broken spinnaker pole upright, hand over hand, teeth gritted. Rook is down on his knees holding its foot
shots.camera: Low off the bow, tilting up with the pole

shots.action: A small storm jib goes up the pole, shakes, and fills. She hauls on the halyard, looks up at it, and for the first time her face eases
shots.camera: From the side, low, rising with the sail

shots.action: Wide, from the side: the dismasted yacht under one small sail, moving through the swell. She is at the wheel; Rook stands on the roof, a wing shading his eyes
shots.camera: Abeam, tracking, closing slowly

shots.action: Looking aft and up from the roof: an aircraft comes in low over the stern, straight at us, growing fast. At the wheel she throws her head back and both arms up
shots.camera: Low on the roof, tilting up as it comes

shots.action: From the aircraft: a small white hull on a very large sea. Two figures on the roof, jumping, arms going: her, shouting, and Rook waving both wings
shots.camera: High above, climbing away and rolling

shots.action: Over her shoulder: the aircraft is already small, and getting smaller. Her arms come down. She turns her head; she has stopped shouting
shots.camera: Behind her, level, easing in

shots.action: At the bow, over his shoulder: Rook has a small brass telescope to his eye. On the horizon two ships cross, a long way off, and keep going. He lowers the glass and turns his head back to us; his brows have dropped
shots.camera: Behind his shoulder at the bow, the horizon across the frame

shots.action: Rook's board: a sea chart pinned at the corners. A dashed course runs up from Tahiti to a red cross; from the cross an orange line starts west and runs all the way to Hawaii. 1,500 MILES
shots.camera: Flat, the chart swaying on its pins

shots.action: On the roof she stands braced with a brass sextant at her eye, aimed at the sun. Beside her Rook taps his beak, follows the line of it up to the sun, then looks at her and nods once
shots.camera: Front three-quarter two-shot, easing round

shots.action: Close on her face: the sextant at her eye, its arm moving a hair at a time, the sun flashing in the little mirror. Her eye is narrowed, steady
shots.camera: Close, three-quarter, drifting round

shots.action: Below, a floorboard up: her hand comes out of the black bilge water holding a wristwatch, dripping. The second hand is still going round
shots.camera: Close and low over the open bilge, rising with the hand

shots.action: She steers, worn out. Behind her the sky runs through day, dusk, night and dawn, twice; a count runs up to DAY 41. Rook crouches at the coaming scratching one more mark for each day
shots.camera: Front three-quarter from the side deck, easing in

shots.action: Night, an island's lights along the horizon. A ship's searchlight swings across the black water and stops on the wreck. At the bow Rook is waving both wings; at the wheel she turns to the light
shots.camera: Off the stern quarter, the ship beyond the yacht

shots.action: Close on her at the wheel: the beam hits her face, white. Her eyes go wide, then screw shut; a hand comes up against the glare and her mouth opens
shots.camera: Close on her face, easing in

shots.action: From above and behind: the ship ahead with a towline down to the yacht's bow, where Rook stands pointing the way; a green light on the end of a breakwater slides past, the town beyond
shots.camera: High astern, sinking and closing

shots.action: Rook on the roof, harbour lights behind him. He looks back towards her at the wheel: his eyes go wide, his hat leaves his head, and a feather comes loose
shots.camera: Close on Rook, easing in

shots.action: The chart again: the orange line now runs the whole way from the red cross to Hawaii. 41 DAYS is stamped under it, then ALONE
shots.camera: Flat, the chart swaying on its pins

shots.action: Dawn, in harbour, the water still. Low on the side deck: the orange line is still on its cleat, hanging over the side. Rook stands over it with his hat held to his chest, and bows his head
shots.camera: Low outside the rail, rising slowly

shots.action: Another year, another boat: a small sloop with her mast standing and both sails full, heeling to a clean breeze in bright sun. She is at the helm, looking ahead
shots.camera: Off the bow, low, tracking

shots.action: Close on Rook at dawn: he puts his hat back on, settles the brim, and looks straight at us
shots.camera: Close, level

shots.action: Rook on the end of the breakwater at dawn, the dismasted yacht lying quiet in the harbour behind him. He lets go of his brim and looks out to sea
shots.camera: Three-quarter, easing in

shots.action: Back in the flooded cabin, running backwards to where it began: her head goes down on the settee, her eyes close, the water slops under her
shots.camera: Close above her face, the opening move reversed
